properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 13 at 1:12AM CDT until September 13 at 8:00AM CDT by NWS Wichita KS
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Allen County in southeastern Kansas...
Neosho County in southeastern Kansas...
Northeastern Wilson County in southeastern Kansas...
Woodson County in southeastern Kansas...

* WHEN...Until 800 AM CDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 112 AM CDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly
in the warned area. Between 2 and 4 inches of rain have fallen.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Chanute, Iola, Humboldt, Yates Center, Erie, St. Paul, La Harpe,
Gas, Neosho Falls, Galesburg, Savonburg, Elsmore, Stark, Earlton,
Bassett, Petrolia, Iola Airport and Chanute Airport.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 13 at 7:42AM EDT until September 13 at 9:30AM EDT by NWS Upton NY
properties.description:
At 742 AM EDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated that
heavy rain was falling across the warned area. Between 1 and 2.5
inches of rain have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 1 to 2
inches in 1 hour. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1.5 inches
are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is already occurring.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Heavy rain producing flash
flooding.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams, urban
areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Paterson, Passaic, Wayne, Bloomfield, Orange, Paramus, Lyndhurst,
Rutherford, Caldwell, Kearny, Hawthorne, Fairfield, Clifton, East
Orange, West Orange, Montclair, Belleville, Fair Lawn, Garfield and
Livingston.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

Excessive runoff from heavy rainfall will cause flooding of urban
areas, highways, streets and underpasses as well as other drainage
areas and low lying spots.

If you are in a basement, be prepared to move to a higher floor.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 13 at 1:47AM EDT until September 13 at 8:30AM EDT by NWS Charleston WV
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by prior excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...East Central Braxton County in north central West
Virginia...
Northwestern Webster County in northeastern West Virginia...
Southern Lewis County in northern West Virginia...

* WHEN...Until 830 AM EDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. Some roads
remain closed due to flooding.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 146 AM EDT, local law enforcement reported that very heavy
rain occurred in the warned area from thunderstorms on Saturday.
Flooding is already occurring. Between 3.5 and 6.5 inches of rain
fell on Saturday.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Falls Mills.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
